title: World's Fair Chicago 1934 Poster
coreRelationships: The large, bold '1934' text is centrally placed and integrated into the cityscape, with the '9' and '3' framing the central tower.
The foreground features two distinct architectural styles (European-inspired buildings) flanking a body of water, creating a visual frame for the more modern, distant cityscape.
The human figures are small in scale compared to the architecture, emphasizing the grandeur of the fair and its global scope.
The sky is a solid, deep blue, punctuated by stylized white clouds that provide a soft contrast to the sharp architectural lines.
The text at the top and bottom of the poster acts as a strong informational frame for the central visual narrative.
reuseFormula: Recreate a vintage travel poster for a large-scale event, using a limited, vibrant color palette and a flat, geometric Art Deco style. Feature a stylized cityscape with a prominent central landmark and large, integrated year text. Include a body of water with small boats and groups of stylized figures in the foreground, all framed by bold promotional text at the top and bottom.
